title: Trump: pilots say spheres outfly F-22s

tellings.quote: Donald Trump has said, "I've had Air Force pilots, you know, very, very good guy, better than Tom Cruz, uh, and come out and say, you know, we've had spherical objects, circular objects out fly our F-22s.

plain: Donald Trump has said that Air Force pilots, "better than Tom Cruise", told him they had seen spherical, circular objects outfly the F-22, the Air Force's top fighter jet. The writer and analyst Marik von Rennenkampff quotes Trump on the show, as a sign that such reports reached the White House.
